subject: Update crash wording to include our repo (#263)
reason: The change only edits static log-message strings in bugReportEnd (the crash bug-report footer), swapping Redis wording and URLs for Valkey ones. No command behaviour, reply, replication, persistence or control-flow path changes, so there is nothing an experiment's oracles or a compared sequence could observe short of deliberately crashing the server to read log text, which the fuzzer's oracles treat as a failure. No scenario is needed.
